source_quotes: First live run of the keyword validation gate rejected ufw/fail2ban/loopback ... the judge had NO content
a sound removal gate: real content, unanimity to remove, no evidence = no removal, probe real model first, kill switch
overlap_check: method_36 (30036) measures content depth for persist gates; method_30 covers enforcement severity. Neither covers removal gates. New.

payload.name: Gates That Remove Data Must See Evidence
payload.description: A gate that can remove stored data sees the real content, needs unanimity to remove, removes nothing without evidence, is probed on the real model first, and has a kill switch.

principles.name: Absence of evidence is not a verdict
principles.description: A model given only a title says no to specific terms it cannot verify, so a single no must not delete.

principles.name: Removal is asymmetric
principles.description: Keeping a wrong item costs little; deleting a right one loses real value.

heuristics.condition: the same list gets different answers on repeated rounds
heuristics.action: treat the difference as a reason for the unanimity rule, not a reason to average

heuristics.condition: a gate's first live run removes a valuable specific term
heuristics.action: stop, restore from the before-copy, and fix what the judge could not see

decision_rules.name: Give the judge the content
decision_rules.condition: a gate judges whether stored data should be removed
decision_rules.outcome: provide the real content, read from wherever it is stored (data directory and application root), not only a name or title

decision_rules.name: Remove only on unanimity
decision_rules.condition: a gate runs several rounds on a stored item
decision_rules.outcome: remove an existing item only if every round says no, and store a new item only if every round says yes

decision_rules.name: No content means no removal
decision_rules.outcome: leave the item untouched and report that it was not judged

decision_rules.name: Probe before deploy
decision_rules.condition: a removal gate is about to be deployed
decision_rules.outcome: run its exact prompt against the real model on a real container and read the result before it is allowed to remove anything

decision_rules.name: Provide a kill switch
decision_rules.outcome: give it a named switch that turns removal off without a rebuild
